cr_data.provenance:
The work sold to Courtland Barns in 1949. 
In 1955, the artist purchased the work from Barns through Downtown gallery 
In 1957 was purchased by the Winston and Marshall group from Downtown Gallery and gifted to the Roswell Museum and Art Center. 
(Source: Roswell Museum and Art Center, 2025)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Sold. infor. fr. Downtown Gal, Oct. 1949." Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Note: Belongs to Mrs. Courtland Barnes, N. York." Reproduced and titled *Ram's Head and Autumn Leaves* in *Apollo* (April 1938). See cat. nos. 848, 852, 2026. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
